name: eye-clinic
description: Nethraloka Ayurvedic Eye Clinic — Patient System

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.build:render: npm ci && npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --include=dev --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
